shortDescription: PARIS and NEW YORK, Sept. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Pasqal NASDAQ:PSQL, a global leader in neutral-atom quantum computing, today announced the date for the release of its financial results for the first half of 2026, covering the six months ended June 30, 2026, and its participation in upcoming…

children: , a global leader in neutral-atom quantum computing, today announced the date for the release of its financial results for the first half of 2026, covering the six months ended June 30, 2026, and its participation in upcoming investor conferences.

Pasqal will report its first half 2026 financial results before the open of U.S. financial markets on Thursday, September 24, 2026. Pasqal will host a conference call with the financial community that day at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time to discuss the results. A live webcast and archived replay of the call will be available on Pasqal’s
. To access the conference call by phone, please dial 1-877-497-9071 (U.S. and Canada) or 1-201-689-8727 (international).

helps organizations tackle problems that are difficult or impossible to solve with conventional computing methods alone. Founded in 2019 on Nobel Prize–winning research, Pasqal builds and operates neutral-atom quantum computers, delivered with a full software stack, for industry, science, and governments. Pasqal's production-ready systems are available both on-premises and through the cloud, enabling organizations to harness quantum computing without requiring in-house quantum expertise. A single hardware platform supports analog workloads today and is designed to evolve toward fault-tolerant quantum computing in the future.

Headquartered in France with operations globally, Pasqal’s quantum computing systems are used by customers across energy, financial services and advanced materials to address complex challenges. Pasqal’s customers include Saudi Aramco, Crédit Agricole CIB, LG Electronics and supported by partnerships with NVIDIA and IBM (Pasqal is part of the IBM Quantum Network).

title: Pasqal Announces First Half 2026 Earnings Release Date and Participation in Upcoming Investor Conferences
